assumptions.missing_values: None in these examples. Full source missingness is not established.
assumptions.period_note: Periods are chosen for demonstration and are not inferred monthly cohort coverage.
assumptions.file_relationship: Shared synthetic patient identifiers. Codified and NLP files generated independently. No patient-feature crosswalk or clinical correlations inferred.
assumptions.formats: Codified month and year are strings; NLP month and year are integers. Codified patient_num is represented as full decimal text in CSV for lossless integer64 conversion; NLP patient_num is numeric.
assumptions.source_grouping: The codified source has grouped_df class, but grouping columns were not supplied. CSV has no grouping attributes. The optional RData conversion creates a plain data.frame with the observed column types.
assumptions.codes: Generated format examples, not verified clinical codes or dictionary mappings.

search_rules: Provide monthly examples; raw and daily-level files are available according to the original README.
Count column is Group_Code_Count for codified data and N for NLP data.
The source site is UPMC even though the monthly files are stored under the MGB/MS-AD path.
Dictionary paths are not documented; do not substitute MGB or IBD dictionaries.
NLP feature_id can contain AB-prefixed acronym concepts.
Use full decimal synthetic IDs. Do not reproduce the codified integer64 display artifact.
Do not use source row counts as patient counts or fake values as real distributions.
